Adel Sisy

A young entrepreneur and co-founder of Online Knowledge LLC, where he’s leading the way in creating innovative solutions for education and life sciences. Adel is also the co-founder of InspiredK.org, a certified 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to empowering highschool students, college learners, and young adults through hands-on learning in Artificial Intelligence, science, and engineering research.
